 Using the sum function in HPA 
```{r}
genes_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
genes_pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
genes_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)

print(genes_human)
print(genes_mouse)
print(genes_pig)
```
Humans have the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
